name: Agentic AI offensive frameworks (ARTEX, CAIRN, CyberStrikeAI, PentAGI, STRIX, HexStrike-AI), Sep-Nov 2026
description: Techniques observed in public reporting of operators using open-source agentic offensive frameworks. Score = number of independent evidence rows in examples/agentic-ai-attacks and the reference doc splunk-sentinel-query-builder/references/agentic-ai-attacks.md. Built against ATT&CK v20; T1574.001 (DLL) covers what earlier versions called T1574.002 DLL Side-Loading.
